sentences.text: Monoglobus pectinilyticus is an anaerobic pectinolytic bacterium isolated from human faeces, whose cells are Gram-stain-positive, non-motile cocci about 0.6 micrometres in diameter.
A case-control study reported significant depletion of commensal species including Monoglobus pectinilyticus in multiple sclerosis.
Another study identified Monoglobus pectinilyticus among bacteria significantly enriched in participants with obesity.
